title: Warm Spicy Slovakian Pork Belly Skewers
description: Tangy and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring pork belly slices, infused oil, and a blend of spices, perfect for a romantic evening, and can be adapted to be flexitarian-friendly by substituting some ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the sliced pork belly to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the pork belly pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
While the skewers are cooking, mix the lemon juice and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are done, brush them with the lemon juice and parsley mixture.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
